definitions.explanation: A student in their first year of a given school level — elementary first-grader, first-year junior high or high school student, or first-year university student. The school level is clarified by context or by prefixing it (e.g., {小学|しょうがく}{一年生|いちねんせい}).

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{今|いま}{一年生|いちねんせい}だ。
examples.english: My son is in first grade now.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{一年生|いちねんせい}のときに{出会|であ}った。
examples.english: We met when I was a freshman in university.

examples.japanese: {小学|しょうがく}{一年生|いちねんせい}になると、ランドセルを{背負|せお}って{学校|がっこう}に{通|かよ}い{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: When you become a first-grader, you start going to school carrying a randoseru backpack.

notes:
Compound of {一年|いちねん} (one year) + {生|せい} (student). Can refer to any first-year level, with the school type either prefixed or understood from context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小学|しょうがく}{一年生|いちねんせい}: first-grader (elementary)
- {中学|ちゅうがく}{一年生|いちねんせい}: first-year junior high student
- {高校|こうこう}{一年生|いちねんせい}: first-year high school student
- {大学|だいがく}{一年生|いちねんせい}: university freshman
- {一年生|いちねんせい}になる: to become a first-year student

USAGE:
Can also describe a beginner or newcomer in any field, e.g., {社会人|しゃかいじん}{一年生|いちねんせい} (someone in their first year of working life).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {二年生|にねんせい}: second-year student
- {三年生|さんねんせい}: third-year student
- {新入生|しんにゅうせい}: new student (just entered)
